 area_run.get(
                        "critical_path_delay_picoseconds"
                    ),
                }
            )

    scope = formal.get("scope")
    if not isinstance(scope, dict):
        raise TimingEvidenceError("formal proof scope is malformed")
    if scope.get("source_sweep_runs") != total_runs:
        raise TimingEvidenceError("formal scope sweep count differs from source evidence")
    if scope.get("unique_mapped_netlists_proved") != len(analyses):
        raise TimingEvidenceError("formal scope unique-proof count differs from timed analyses")
    return analyses


def _analysis_script(module: str, contract: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    top = _safe_module(module, context="analysis.module")
    clock = contract["virtual_clock_name"]
    period = _tcl_number(float(contract["virtual_clock_period_ns"]))
    input_delay = _tcl_number(float(contract["input_delay_ns"]))
    output_delay = _tcl_number(float(contract["output_delay_ns"]))
    output_load = _tcl_number(float(contract["output_load_pf"]))
    driving_cell = contract["driving_cell"]
    group_count = int(contract["group_path_count"])
    endpoint_count = int(contract["endpoint_path_count"])
    digits = int(contract["digits"])
    commands = [
        "read_liberty ../../../technology/technology.lib",
        "read_verilog input.v",
        f"link_design {top}",
        f"create_clock -name {clock} -period {period}",
        f"set_input_delay -clock {clock} {input_delay} [all_inputs]",
        f"set_output_delay -clock {clock} {output_delay} [all_outputs]",
        f"set_driving_cell -lib_cell {driving_cell} [all_inputs]",
        f"set_load {output_load} [all_outputs]",
        f'puts "HEPHAESTUS_PERIOD_NS {period}"',
        f'puts "HEPHAESTUS_INPUT_DELAY_NS {input_delay}"',
        f'puts "HEPHAESTUS_OUTPUT_DELAY_NS {output_delay}"',
        f'puts "HEPHAESTUS_OUTPUT_LOAD_PF {output_load}"',
        f'puts "HEPHAESTUS_DRIVING_CELL {driving_cell}"',
        "if { ![check_setup -verbose] } {",
        '  puts "HEPHAESTUS_ERROR check_setup_failed"',
        "  exit 2",
        "}",
        "report_units",
        'puts "HEPHAESTUS_BEGIN_UNCONSTRAINED"',
        (
            "report_checks -unconstrained -path_delay max "
            f"-group_path_count {group_count} -endpoint_path_count {endpoint_count} "
            f"-digits {digits}"
        ),
        'puts "HEPHAESTUS_END_UNCONSTRAINED"',
        'puts "HEPHAESTUS_BEGIN_MAX_PATHS"',
        (
            "report_checks -path_delay max "
            f"-group_path_count {group_count} -endpoint_path_count {endpoint_count} "
            f"-sort_by_slack -digits {digits} "
            "-fields {slew capacitance input_pin net fanout}"
        ),
        'puts "HEPHAESTUS_END_MAX_PATHS"',
        f"report_worst_slack -max -digits {digits}",
        f"report_tns -max -digits {digits}",
        "report_design_area",
        "exit 0",
        "",
    ]
    return "\n".join(commands)


def _section(text: str, begin: str, end: str) -> str:
    pattern = re.compile(re.escape(begin) + r"\n(.*?)\n" + re.escape(end), re.DOTALL)
    match = pattern.search(text)
    if match is None:
        raise TimingEvidenceError(f"OpenSTA output is missing section {begin!r}")
    return match.group(1)


def _parse_one(pattern: str, text: str, *, context: str) -> float:
    matches = re.findall(pattern, text, re.MULTILINE)
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise TimingEvidenceError(f"{context}: expected one value, found {matches}")
    result = float(matches[0])
    if not math.isfinite(result):
        raise TimingEvidenceError(f"{context}: value is not finite")
    return result


def _parse_output(text: str, *, context: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    errors = [line for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith("Error:")]
    if errors or "HEPHAESTUS_ERROR" in text:
        raise TimingEvidenceError(
            f"OpenSTA reported errors for {context}: {errors[:3]}"
        )
    unconstrained = _section(
        text,
        "HEPHAESTUS_BEGIN_UNCONSTRAINED",
        "HEPHAESTUS_END_UNCONSTRAINED",
    )
    maximum = _section(text, "HEPHAESTUS_BEGIN_MAX_PATHS", "HEPHAESTUS_END_MAX_PATHS")
    if "Startpoint:" in unconstrained or "Endpoint:" in unconstrained:
        raise TimingEvidenceError("OpenSTA found unconstrained paths for {context}")
    startpoints = re.findall(r"^Startpoint:\s*(.+)$", maximum, re.MULTILINE)
    endpoints = re.findall(r"^Endpoint:\s*(.+)$", maximum, re.MULTILINE)
    arrivals = [
        float(value)
        for value in re.findall(
            r"^\s*([+-]?[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s+data arrival time\s*$",
            maximum,
            re.MULTILINE,
        )
    ]
    if not startpoints or not endpoints or not arrivals:
        raise TimingEvidenceError(f"OpenSTA did not report a detailed max path for {context}")
    if len(startpoints) != len(endpoints) or len(arrivals) != len(startpoints):
        raise TimingEvidenceError(
            f"OpenSTA path sections are inconsistent for {context}"
        )
    period = _parse_one(
        r"^HEPHAESTUS_PERIOD_NS\s+([-+0-9.eE]+)\s*$",
        text,
        context=f"{context}.period",
    )
    worst_slack = _parse_one(
        r"^worst slack max\s+([-+0-9.eE]+)\s*$",
        text,
        context=f"{context}.worst_slack",
    )
    tns = _parse_one(
        r"^tns max\s+([-+0-9.eQ]+)\s*$",
        text,
        context=f"{context}.tns",
    )
    derived_delay = period - worst_slack
    if derived_delay <= 0:
        raise TimingEvidenceError(f"OpenSTA reported a non-positive delay for {context}")
    worst_arrival = max(arrivals)
    if not math.isclose(derived_delay, worst_arrival, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=1e-5):
        raise TimingEvidenceError(
            f"OpenSTA slack-derived and path-reported delays disagree for {context}: "
            f"{derived_delay} vs {worst_arrival}"
        )
    return {
        "reported_path_count": len(arrivals),
        "startpoints": startpoints,
        "endpoints": endpoints,
        "arrival_times_ns": arrivals,
        "worst_data_arrival_ns": worst_arrival,
        "virtual_clock_period_ns": period,
        "worst_slack_ns": worst_slack,
        "total_negative_slack_ns": tns,
        "slack_derived_data_delay_ns": derived_delay,
        "unconstrained_paths_found": False,
        "warning_lines": [line for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith("Warning:")],
    }


def _run_once(
    *,
    executable: Path,
    run_dir: Path,
    attempt: int,
    timeout_seconds: int,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    stdout = run_dir / f"opensta.{attempt}.stdout.txt"
    stderr = run_dir / f"opensta.{attempt}.stderr.txt"
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(
            [str(executable), "analysis.tcl"],
            cwd=run_dir,
            check=False,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=timeout_seconds,
         )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        raise TimingEvidenceError(&"OpenSTA timed out for {run_dir.name}") from exc
    stdout.write_text
